This file defines rules/ownership for all RusToK contributors and AI agents.

Always start by reading [`docs/index.md`](docs/index.md) — the canonical documentation map. Review domain module documentation before changes. Use module owners (or platform team) for cross-cutting approvals. Capture architecture decisions in `DECISIONS/` using an ADR.

Platform: `crates/rustok-core`, `apps/server`, shared infra. Domains: `crates/rustok-*`. Frontends: `apps/admin`, `apps/storefront`, `apps/next-admin`, `apps/next-frontend`. MCP: `crates/rustok-mcp`. Tooling: `scripts/`, `docker-compose*.yml`, `grafana/`, `prometheus/`. Ownership: [`docs/modules/registry.md`](docs/modules/registry.md).

`docs/` is Russian; public contracts, `AGENTS.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, and crate `README.md` files are English. Mixed language within a single document is not allowed — choose one language per file.

Platform docs live in `docs/`; component docs in `apps/<name>/docs/` or `crates/<name>/docs/`. Every app/crate root `README.md` must state purpose, responsibilities, interactions, entry points, and link to `docs/`. `docs/modules/_index.md` links module docs.

For architecture, API, events, modules, tenancy, routing, UI contracts, or observability changes: update local docs, central `docs/`, [`docs/index.md`](docs/index.md), and (for added/renamed modules/apps) [`docs/modules/registry.md`](docs/modules/registry.md); mark outdated docs `deprecated` or `archived` and link replacements.

Do not create a new document if a suitable one already exists — extend the existing one.
Documentation must reflect the actual state of the code.
Never bypass or disable pre-commit/pre-push hooks. Fix the root cause of failures.
Do not edit CI/CD workflow files unless explicitly requested.
Do not modify other branches — only work on the assigned task branch.
